svg.title: A 16-bit Bloom filter with three hash functions per URL
svg.desc: a.com/x set bits 2, 7 and 11; b.org/y set bits 4, 7 and 13. Checking c.net/z hits bits 2, 4 and 13, all set, so it reads as probably seen although it was never added: a false positive. Checking d.io/w hits bits 1, 7 and 9; bit 1 is 0, so it is definitely new.
svg.text: Bloom filter: 16 bits, 3 hashes per URL
c = c.net/z hits 2, 4, 13: all 1, so "probably seen".
It was never added. That is a false positive.
d = d.io/w hits 1, 7, 9: bit 1 is 0, so "definitely new".
A Bloom filter can be wrong about "seen", never about "new".
